**Stay off your phone and a tree grows. Leave early and it withers. That's Forest, the focus timer used by 60 million people worldwide.**

Top productivity app in 136 countries. Recommended by The New York Times and Business Insider.

"Forest works well, and if your goal is to be more in the moment, ignore your phone and actually talk to your friends when you are with them, this is the app for you." — The New York Times

Together, our community has planted over 2 million real trees on Earth through our partnership with Trees for the Future.

---

STAY FOCUSED

Forest helps you overcome phone addiction, reduce distractions, and build deep work habits. Whether you are studying for exams, working from home, or simply trying to be more present, Forest gives you a reason to stay on task.

- A gamified focus timer that turns screen-free time into a growing virtual forest
- Create personalized Allow Lists to block distracting apps during focus sessions (iOS 16 or above)
- Track your daily phone usage and screen time

GET MOTIVATED

- Unlock tree species and soundscapes as you reach focus milestones
- Co-plant trees with friends and family during shared focus sessions
- Compete with users around the world and share your forest
- Unlock achievements and earn extra rewards
- Plant real trees on Earth through our partnership with Trees for the Future

TIME GUARD: BLOCK DISTRACTIONS ON SCHEDULE

Time Guard helps you set phone-free windows throughout your day. Block distracting apps on a schedule, limit when you can access them, and track how much time you spend on your phone.

MINDFUL SPACE: RESET YOUR MIND

Mindful Space combines calming soundscapes, breathing exercises, and gentle animations to help you decompress between focus sessions. 

STATISTICS & INSIGHTS

- Create custom tags and view detailed statistics of how you spend your focused time
- Review your weekly, monthly, and yearly focus history as a visual forest
- Revisit your focus journey with Forest Timeline
- Sync your focused time with Apple Health

It is never too late to build better habits.

---

FOREST PLUS

Love Forest? Try Forest Plus.

- 3x coin rewards and unlock new trees faster
- Exclusive Plus-only tree species and early access to seasonal new trees
- Turn your focus into a real tree on Earth

Start your free trial today, cancel anytime.

---

NOTICE

Forest is available on iPhone and iPad. Sign in with the same account to sync your data and access Forest Plus across all platforms.

The Allow List feature requires iOS/iPadOS 16 or above. Forest is the original app. Similar apps on the App Store are not developed by the Forest team.

---

Follow us on Instagram or visit forestapp.cc to learn more. Browser extensions also available.

---

Get from A to B with Forest, London’s homegrown shared ebike.

Switch your usual journey by train or bus for a faster, fun, and more sustainable way to get around. Plus, we’re the only shared ebike app that after a £1 unlock, gives you up to 30 free ride minutes on every Pay As You Go (PAYG) ride.

HOW TO GET STARTED:
1. Download the app, create a free account and accept our Terms and Conditions.
2. Find your nearest Forest bike out of thousands across London using the map in the app.
3. Unlock a bike for £1 using the QR codes on the bike itself, or by tapping the selected bike on the app.
4. Enjoy an emissions free ride!

WAYS TO RIDE:
1. PAYG: Simply unlock a bike for £1, get up to 30 free ride minutes, then pay 29p thereafter.
2. Buy a bundle: If you’re making longer trips, or planning multiple trips over a longer time.
3. Subscribe to Forest Plus: If you want the best value riding option.

Always ride responsibly, respect other road users, and follow the safety guidance provided in the Forest app.

WHY YOU SHOULD RIDE WITH FOREST:
Choose from thousands of ebikes available across 18 boroughs of London with free ride minutes available every day. Gain additional free ride minutes by watching ads.
We’re B Corp Certified and have run a zero-emissions operation since day one.

results.description:
Flora is a new way to stay off your phone, clear to-do lists, and build positive, life-changing habits. Whenever you want to make progress towards your goals, plant a seed in Flora. As you work hard, the seed will grow into a healthy tree. Let the tree be your coach and grow yourself with it. You will be amazed by how great you can be.

FOCUS TREES

Have trouble putting down the phone? Flora blocks distracting apps in a pleasant way to help you focus on what’s more important in real life. If you cannot resist the temptation of using your phone and leave the app while growing a tree, the tree will be killed! But if succeeding, you'll unlock new trees.

DOUBLE EFFICIENCY WITH FRIENDS 

Things get even more interesting when you challenge your friends to plant trees together—you will see who kills a tree (ouch). However, if you successfully stay away from your phones together, each of you will win an additional tree from a random friend. You can also chat and share your progress to motivate each other and keep everyone on track.*

* Flora is the original app for multi-user tree planting and delivers the best features that help you and your friends be productive. 

TO-DO LIST & WIDGET

Flora is a to-do list, and more. Simply create a to-do item and set a reminder, then you will never forget a thing. Even better, you can tag your trees with a to-do item to easily track the progress towards each of your life goals. No matter if your goal is daily, weekly, or monthly, Flora will help you follow it through and achieve it.

HABIT TRACKER

Enjoy a rewarding daily habit routine. If you grow trees regularly, you will earn yourself a beautiful, vibrant garden. Take a look at it and feel proud of yourself! Each tree records your perseverance and a step towards a healthy life. You can also view the daily, weekly, or monthly statistics of your activities in Flora to find opportunities to improve your time-management and planning skills.

REAL TREES, REAL IMPACT

Why not plant REAL trees while improving yourself? Flora proudly offers the opt-in Price and Care services that let you plant real trees on the earth if you kill or successfully grow a tree in the app. We partner with tree-planting organizations in Africa and East Asia, such as the Trees.org and Eden Reforestation Projects, to plant fast-growing soil rebuilding trees, fruit trees that diversify incomes and nutrition, and trees that can provide forage and fuel-wood. All these trees help make the earth greener and provide long-term financial aid to families who need it most.

Sounds good? Download Flora and join our 2,000,000+ productive users now!
